parentNote.en: Every question is answered in the app. Each goal has a short home activity: say the words aloud together, and let your child guess first.
parentNote.ar: كل الأسئلة الطفل بيحلها جوه البرنامج، ولكل هدف نشاط قصير في البيت. قولوا الكلمات بصوت عالي مع بعض، وسيبوا طفلك يتوقع الأول.

steps.title: Story time: Not So Fast, Songololo
steps.prompt: Tap each part of the story to listen.

options.label: Beginning. Shepherd goes shopping with his old granny, Gogo. His old tackies (trainers) have holes.
Middle. In a shop window, Shepherd sees shiny new red tackies.
End. Gogo buys the red tackies for him. Shepherd feels so proud!

steps.explanation: The setting is where a story happens: at home, at school, in the park.
steps.shortExplanation: The setting is where a story happens: at home, at school, in the park.

englishVisual.title: Not So Fast, Songololo
englishVisual.text: A story set at the shops, from South Africa.

steps.title: More stories in places we know

options.label: Shark in the Park. Timothy looks through his telescope and shouts: a shark! But the fin is only a cat's ear.
Mr Gumpy's Outing. Children and animals squabble on Mr Gumpy's boat, and it tips over!
Ruby's Worry. Ruby's Worry grows bigger every day. When she talks about it, it shrinks away.
Katie Morag and the Tiresome Ted. Katie Morag is cross about her new baby sister, so she throws her teddy into the sea.

steps.explanation: We can tell how a character feels from what they do and say.
steps.shortExplanation: We can tell how a character feels from what they do and say.

steps.title: Feeling detectives

options.label: If someone grins, they are happy.
If someone sobs, they are sad.
If someone shakes, they are scared.

steps.explanation: What a character does gives us a clue about how they feel.
steps.shortExplanation: What a character does gives us a clue about how they feel.

steps.title: Where is it set?

options.label: The children sit at desks and the teacher reads to them.
Gogo buys bananas and looks at shoes in a window.
Timothy looks at the swings and the slide.

steps.hint: Look for clues: desks, shoes in a window, swings.
steps.explanation: Desks mean school, a shop window means the shops, and swings mean the park.
steps.shortExplanation: Desks mean school, a shop window means the shops, and swings mean the park.

source.answerKeyText: a school • b shops • c park

steps.title: The new red tackies
steps.prompt: Who bought Shepherd his new red tackies?
steps.hint: He went shopping with his old granny.
steps.explanation: Gogo, his granny, bought Shepherd the new red tackies.
steps.shortExplanation: Gogo, his granny, bought Shepherd the new red tackies.

steps.title: Shark in the Park
steps.prompt: What did Timothy really see through his telescope?
steps.hint: The shark fin was really an ear.
steps.explanation: It was only a cat. Its ear looked like a shark fin.
steps.shortExplanation: It was only a cat. Its ear looked like a shark fin.

source.answerKeyText: A cat (its ear looked like a shark fin)

steps.title: Ruby's Worry
steps.hint: What did Ruby do with the boy she met?
steps.explanation: When Ruby talked about her Worry, it shrank until it was gone.
steps.shortExplanation: When Ruby talked about her Worry, it shrank until it was gone.

source.answerKeyText: She talked about it / told someone about her Worry.

steps.title: Feeling verbs
steps.prompt: Does each verb show happy, sad or scared?
steps.hint: Act each word out. What face do you make?
steps.explanation: Grinned and laughed are happy, sobbed and cried are sad, shook and trembled are scared.
steps.shortExplanation: Grinned and laughed are happy, sobbed and cried are sad, shook and trembled are scared.

source.answerKeyText: happy: grinned, laughed • sad: sobbed, cried • scared: shook, whispered

steps.title: Names with titles
steps.prompt: Which sentence is written the right way?

options.label: Uncle arjun jumped in the boat.
Uncle Arjun jumped in the boat.
uncle Arjun jumped in the boat.

steps.hint: Uncle is part of the name, so it needs a capital too.
steps.explanation: Uncle Arjun needs two capitals, and the sentence ends with a full stop.
steps.shortExplanation: Uncle Arjun needs two capitals, and the sentence ends with a full stop.

source.answerKeyText: Uncle Arjun jumped in the boat.

steps.title: Add s or es
steps.prompt: More than one: does each word add s or es?
steps.hint: Words ending in sh add es. Clap dish-es.
steps.explanation: Dish and bush end with sh, so they add es. Mug and bottle add s.
steps.shortExplanation: Dish and bush end with sh, so they add es. Mug and bottle add s.

steps.title: A story in the park
steps.prompt: Tap the three parts of this park story in order.

options.label: The dog ran away after a ball!
Sam found the dog by the slide, and they went home.
Sam went to the park with his dog.

steps.hint: How does it start, what goes wrong, and how does it finish?
steps.explanation: It starts at the park, the dog runs away, and Sam finds him at the end.
steps.shortExplanation: It starts at the park, the dog runs away, and Sam finds him at the end.

source.answerKeyText: Three lines that follow on: something happens at the start, a problem or adventure in the middle, and a finish at the end — all in a park.

steps.title: The setting
steps.prompt: The setting of a story is…
steps.hint: Home, school and the park are settings.
steps.explanation: The setting is where the story happens.
steps.shortExplanation: The setting is where the story happens.

steps.title: Old tackies
steps.hint: Why did he need new ones?
steps.explanation: Shepherd's old tackies had holes, so Gogo bought him new ones.
steps.shortExplanation: Shepherd's old tackies had holes, so Gogo bought him new ones.

steps.title: Mr Gumpy's boat
steps.prompt: In Mr Gumpy's Outing, the boat…
steps.explanation: They did not behave, so the boat tipped over and everyone fell in.
steps.shortExplanation: They did not behave, so the boat tipped over and everyone fell in.

steps.title: Katie Morag
steps.prompt: Katie Morag threw her teddy into the…
steps.explanation: Katie Morag was so cross that she threw her teddy into the sea.
steps.shortExplanation: Katie Morag was so cross that she threw her teddy into the sea.

steps.title: He sobbed
steps.prompt: He sobbed. How did he feel?
steps.hint: Sobbing is a kind of crying.
steps.explanation: Sobbed is a kind of crying, so he felt sad.
steps.shortExplanation: Sobbed is a kind of crying, so he felt sad.

goalActivities.text: Read a picture book together and find the setting on the first page: where does the story happen?
goalActivities.textAr: اقروا كتاب صور مع بعض، ولاقوا مكان القصة في أول صفحة: القصة بتحصل فين؟

goalActivities.text: Talk about a time someone in the family bought or made something special for your child. How did they feel?
goalActivities.textAr: اتكلموا عن مرة حد من العيلة اشترى أو عمل حاجة مميزة لطفلك. حس بإيه ساعتها؟

goalActivities.text: Make a telescope from a kitchen-roll tube. Hide a toy so only a small part shows, and your child guesses what it is.
goalActivities.textAr: اعملوا تلسكوب من رول المطبخ الفاضي. خبّوا لعبة ويبان منها حتة صغيرة بس، وطفلك يخمّن هي إيه.

goalActivities.text: Decorate a worry box. Each of you draws one small worry and talks about it together. Ask: what happened to Ruby's Worry?
goalActivities.textAr: زيّنوا علبة للقلق. كل واحد يرسم حاجة صغيرة قلقاه، واتكلموا عنها مع بعض. واسألوا: قلق روبي حصله إيه؟

goalActivities.text: Use more feeling words during the day: cross, worried, excited, proud. Ask your child to show each one with their face.
goalActivities.textAr: استعملوا كلمات مشاعر أكتر طول اليوم: cross و worried و excited و proud. وخلّي طفلك يورّيك كل واحدة بوشّه.

goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Write the names of family members with their titles: Uncle Ali, Auntie Mona, Granny. Check both capitals.
goalActivities.textAr: اكتبوا أسامي العيلة بألقابهم: Uncle Ali و Auntie Mona و Granny. واتأكدوا من الحرفين الكبار.

goalActivities.text: Count things at dinner: two mugs, three dishes, four bottles. Clap each word and listen for the extra es.
goalActivities.textAr: عدّوا حاجات على العشا: two mugs و three dishes و four bottles. وصقفوا مع كل كلمة واسمعوا الـ es الزيادة.

goalActivities.text: Plan a park story together on three fingers: the beginning, a problem in the middle, and the end. Then your child draws it.
goalActivities.textAr: خطّطوا قصة في الجنينة على تلات صوابع: البداية، ومشكلة في النص، والنهاية. وبعدين طفلك يرسمها.

goalActivities.text: On a walk, stop and say: this could be the setting of a story. What could happen here?
goalActivities.textAr: وانتو ماشيين، وقّفوا وقولوا: ده ممكن يبقى مكان قصة. إيه اللي ممكن يحصل هنا؟

goalActivities.text: Look at your shoes together. Are any old or worn? Talk about why we need new shoes sometimes.
goalActivities.textAr: بصّوا على جزمكم مع بعض. فيه حاجة قديمة أو مدبّلة؟ واتكلموا ليه بنحتاج جزمة جديدة ساعات.

goalActivities.text: Float a bowl in the sink and put small toys in it one by one. When does it tip over?
goalActivities.textAr: عوّموا طبق في الحوض وحطوا فيه لعب صغيرة واحدة واحدة. إمتى يتقلب؟

goalActivities.text: Ask: was Katie Morag really cross with Ted? Who was she really cross with? Let your child explain.
goalActivities.textAr: اسأل: كاتي موراج كانت زعلانة من الدبدوب بجد؟ ولا زعلانة من مين؟ وسيب طفلك يشرح.

goalActivities.text: Read a story and look for feeling clues together: grinned, sobbed, stomped. What does each one tell you?

homeActivities.text: Play "Where am I?": describe a place without naming it ("I can hear a bell. I can see desks.") and your child guesses the setting. Then swap.
